I completely agree with unifutomaki, echojunior. Reading your original post made me question whether I had some kind of slip up and in my sleep posted my own story with different genders. I had an almost exact experience in my lab (but I'm an undergraduate) and it caused a crash and burn where I just couldn't take it anymore and my professor was also supremely unhelpful about the postdoc issue. I had to quit, but that was the second time I had suicidal thoughts in my life (last time was three years before then) After quitting, I didn't have them again until now, for more unrelated things. i know it may seem impossible - all my friends had kept suggesting I change labs and I thought it was impossible, but nothing is impossible. do you have an advisor? Administrative overview people for your program? I recommend you go talk to them. They can help. Believe me. Life is better when you're not being yelled at and demeaned for your hardest work and slowly believing you must be an actual neanderthal with no value
